scope: Two new original wildlife scenes and six original observation questions; no alteration to the nineteen existing videos or their 53 questions.
sourceProcess: Commons original pages, summary, author, licence, date/place fields, history and structured metadata actually read. Author licence and source attribution copied exactly. Original files were downloaded and independently decoded by the separate media-preparation task.
visualProcess: The reviewer read both distributed contact sheets and MP4 frames extracted at exactly2,9,17 seconds. Root independently read the distributed contacts. No uninterrupted playback, audio listening, physical-device check or broad biological certification is claimed.

damwild: Foreground trunks and branches obscure bodies.
The sampled middle side view differs from later rear views.
No total population, exact age or identified food is inferred.
blaesshuhn: Two dark birds show light bill/front-head regions, changing orientations and later strong water reflections.
Feet and swimming lobes are not visible; the movie does not prove the foot anatomy taught in the linked lesson.
The linked foot photograph is a separate source, not a frame extracted from this film.
No specific food, diagnosis or whole-population count is inferred.
